name: Biznet GIO Cloud Compute

evidence.vps: 03: rented virtual compute; the customer chooses the OS image and manages the guest OS and app

line: Prepaid virtual machines with customer managed operating systems.

work.math: The known VM rate is Rp179,000 a month before tax. Whether new customers can get this rate now, and the region pricing, are not confirmed.
The listed monthly VM rate of Rp179,000 is lower than 730 hours at Rp360 an hour. Data transfer has no separate charge.
Rp359,000 for the VM + Rp90,000 for one manual snapshot = Rp449,000 partial subtotal. Snapshot scope and daily backups are not yet confirmed.
